question.name: Question 17
question.problem:
Let the function $f(x,y)$ be defined as

$$
f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}-{y}^{2},\, & \text{if}\,0<x<1,\,0<y<1, \\ {e}^{(x-y)},\, & \text{if}\,1<x<2,\,0<y<1.\end{aligned}
$$

Then,

$$
{∬}_{(0,2)\times (0,1)}f(x,y)\text{ }\text{d}A=
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that the rectangle $R$ can be represented as a union of two smaller rectangles, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}R & =((0,1)\cup (1,2))\times (0,1) \\  & =((0,1)\times (0,1))\cup ((1,2)\times (0,1)).\end{aligned}
$$

So, we can write

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{(0,1)\times (0,1)}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{(1,2)\times (0,1)}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{(0,1)\times (0,1)}({x}^{2}-{y}^{2})\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{(1,2)\times (0,1)}{e}^{(x-y)}\,\text{d}A.\end{aligned}
$$

Let the function f(x,y) be defined as f(x,y)={x2−y2,if0<x<1,0<y<1,e(x−y),if1<x<2,0<y<1. Then, ∬(0,2)×(0,1)f(x,y) dA=

feedback.worked_solution:
First, notice that the rectangle $R$ can be represented as a union of two smaller rectangles, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}R & =((0,1)\cup (1,2))\times (0,1) \\  & =((0,1)\times (0,1))\cup ((1,2)\times (0,1)).\end{aligned}
$$

So, we can write

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{(0,1)\times (0,1)}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{(1,2)\times (0,1)}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{(0,1)\times (0,1)}({x}^{2}-{y}^{2})\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{(1,2)\times (0,1)}{e}^{(x-y)}\,\text{d}A.\end{aligned}
$$
